title: Spicy Thai Yellow Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai yellow curry made with a rich coconut milk sauce and your choice of protein.
instructions: 1. Cook the kanom jeen noodles according to package instructions.
2. In a large pan, heat the yellow curry paste over medium heat until fragrant.
3. Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
4. Pour in the coconut milk, fish sauce, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
5. Bring the curry to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
6. Serve the curry over the cooked noodles and garnish with a squeeze of lime juice.
